obs_cons_geometry: V | U_shadow, where U_shadow = unknown voxels (space==0, z>0.02) inside the camera frustum whose projected depth is behind the observed depth at that pixel
u_outside_frustum: treated as near-ground / free (single-rock scenes are flat)

robust_rehearsal.lateral_rule: action is safe only if max|y - center| <= channel_half - 0.05 for all three perturbations

detour_geometry.offset_m: max |y| of footprint in [x_front, leave_x] + ROBOT_HALF_W(0.20) + 0.10
detour_geometry.note: computed per arm, per candidate for FULL; not a constant

decision.wheel_priority: if cost difference <5% choose wheel action

auto_exposure.rule: if input mean < 100, linearly scale brightness so mean in [120,140], no crop/content change

chassis_contacts: counted from execution records for every arm; >0 is fail
